author: Tolkāppiyar
title: Tolkāppiyam
note: Oldest extant Tamil grammar. Establishes the five-fold grammar system.

author: Puttamittiraṉ (Buddhamitra)
title: Vīracōḻiyam
note: First major Tamil grammar to systematically incorporate Sanskrit grammatical structures. Contains dedicated Yāppatikāram (Prosody chapter).

author: Kā. Ra. Kōvintarāja Mutaliyār (ed.)
title: Vīracōḻiyam Mūlamum Peruntēvaṉār Uraiyum (Critical Edition)
note: Standard critical edition containing the full 184 verses of Vīracōḻiyam along with Peruntēvaṉār’s commentary. This is the most commonly referenced edition in modern scholarship.

author: Peruntēvaṉār
title: Commentary on Vīracōḻiyam
note: Important medieval commentary on Vīracōḻiyam. Available in the 1942/1970 edition published by Pavāṉantar Kaḻakam, Chennai.

author: Amitasāgara
title: Yapparuṅkalam
note: Major treatise dedicated exclusively to Tamil prosody (Yappu).

author: Amitasāgara
title: Yapparuṅkalakkārikai
note: Summary version of Yapparuṅkalam. Widely used for studying Tamil metres.

author: Taṇṭi
title: Taṇṭiyalaṅkāram
note: Tamil adaptation of Sanskrit Daṇḍin’s Kāvyādarśa. Focuses on rhetoric and figures of speech.

author: Pavaṇandi Munivar
title: Nannūl
note: Most widely used Tamil grammar after Tolkāppiyam. Clear five-fold structure with excellent Yāppatikāram section.

author: Mayilaināthar
title: Commentary on Nannūl
note: One of the most famous and widely studied commentaries on Nannūl.

author: Anonymous (Jain scholar)
title: Pirayōka Vivēkam
note: Grammar work showing strong Sanskrit influence, similar to Vīracōḻiyam.

author: Ulrike Niklas
title: Introduction to Tamil Prosody
note: Detailed academic study of Tamil metrical system. Highly recommended for serious study of Yappu.

author: K. Rajarathnam
title: A Linguistic Study of Vīracōḻiyam
note: Modern linguistic analysis of Vīracōḻiyam. Freely available online at: https://journals.kln.ac.lk/jhu/media/attachments/2022/07/04/a-linguistic-study-of-vraciyam.pdf

author: Victor B. D'Avella
title: Kāraka Theory in the Vīracōḻiyam and its Sanskrit Antecedents
note: Scholarly paper on Sanskrit grammatical influence in Vīracōḻiyam. Freely available online.

title: Tamil Prosody
note: Overview of Tamil metrical system and historical development.

title: Latin Prosody
note: Study of Latin poetic metre and its Greek origins.

title: Greek Prosody
note: Classical Greek metrical system and terminology.

title: Tamil Virtual Academy
note: Excellent digital library for classical Tamil texts including Tolkāppiyam, Nannūl, and many commentaries.
